notice: Minimal original context input authored for AUT 250 Week 3. The values below are ILLUSTRATIVE TRAINING LABELS. They are not a real vehicle identity, not verified vehicle data, and not a source of code meaning.

profile.retrievalMethod: Illustrative flash-code output via a self-test connector

contextRequirementNotice: OBD-I code meaning depends on manufacturer, model year, engine, retrieval method and test mode. This profile supplies the context fields, but it does not supply any code definition.
whyThisMatters: The same numeric output can carry different meanings across manufacturers and test modes.
A retrieval performed in the wrong test mode can produce an output that is misinterpreted.
Without a verified manufacturer source, no code meaning may be asserted.
